name: demo-host-chant
description: The demo host (#570) declared in chant: its AWS resources (CloudFormation) and its compose file and Dockerfiles.

scripts.build: npm run build:aws && npm run build:docker
scripts.build:docker: chant build src/docker --lexicon docker -o build/docker/compose.yaml && node scripts/place-docker.mjs
scripts.check: npm run tsc && npm run check:aws && npm run check:docker && npm run lint
scripts.check:aws: chant build src/aws --lexicon aws -o build/template.json && cmp build/template.json template.json
scripts.check:docker: chant build src/docker --lexicon docker -o build/docker/compose.yaml && node scripts/place-docker.mjs --check
scripts.lint: chant lint src && chant lint ops
